relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-host-list
relations.evidence: If the port number is not a part of the hostname, then the port number is assumed to be 8091.

notable_absence.finding: host-list.md never uses the word 'server' at all, and its near-duplicate sibling server-list.md (this same batch) never uses the word 'host' - despite the two commands sharing an identical SYNOPSIS shape, identical HOST FORMATS / CERTIFICATE AUTHENTICATION / ENVIRONMENT AND CONFIGURATION VARIABLES boilerplate, and each linking to the other in SEE ALSO. Neither page glosses why two separate, identically-shaped commands exist for what reads as the same underlying cluster-membership list, or whether 'host' and 'server' denote the same list at all. This is the twin-command redundancy sitting exactly at the seam this round predicted: near-identical siblings plus lighter review equals an unreconciled small inconsistency neither side's page acknowledges.

cross_component_finding: See notable_absence - the host-list/server-list pairing is a clean, concrete instance of copy-pasted-boilerplate siblings with no cross-page reconciliation of their naming difference.
cross_product_finding: Plainly none - the page is too thin to carry any product-comparison signal.
